objective: Implement the smallest local archive and source-admission foundation for VS-01: a minimal Python 3.12 project, read-only macOS archive-volume inspection, deterministic SOURCE-PLAN-01 acquisition dry run, a synthetic content-addressed staging/promotion primitive, three portable receipt contracts, and task-specific CI, without acquiring sources or mutating the real archive.
activated_user_visible_capability: An operator can inspect the proposed BSL-Archive volume and compile an exact machine-readable SOURCE-PLAN-01 acquisition dry run without external-source network access or real-archive mutation.
activated_invariants: No exact volume UUID, device identity, or mount path is assumed; live inspection produces a candidate requiring later owner approval.
Archive inspection is read-only: no write probe, format, partition, rename, mount, unmount, encryption, repair, initialization, or marker creation is permitted.

A candidate is ready only when exactly one BSL-Archive volume is observed on Darwin, APFS and encrypted, external, mounted, not read-only, has stable volume and parent-device identity, has at least 20 GiB free, and its Thunderbolt connection is positively evidenced; otherwise a defined fail-closed state and reasons are emitted.
Failure to prove Thunderbolt attachment is IDENTITY_INCOMPLETE with reason THUNDERBOLT_NOT_PROVEN; the implementation may not invent a new readiness state or infer protocol from a mount path.
No internal-disk, temporary-directory, network-volume, other-removable-volume, or cloud fallback can become authoritative storage.
The full live ArchivePreflightReceipt is owner-private and excluded from Git; public handoffs may contain only its SHA-256, readiness state, non-identifying summary, and local ignored path.
No hostname, username, Mac serial number, hardware UUID, credential, or raw system-profiler output may enter Git, CI, a PR, or the public handoff.
SOURCE-PLAN-01 is the sole source-selection and rights authority; exactly six approved source entries and every hard prohibition are preserved.
No external source URL is fetched, cloned, downloaded, or probed in T01; dependency installation and ordinary GitHub operations remain permitted.
SourceAcquisitionDryRun contains a deterministic semantic payload and RFC 8785 SHA-256; envelope UUIDv7 and timestamp fields are excluded from that semantic hash.
Content-addressed promotion is proven only with synthetic bytes inside explicitly non-authoritative temporary fixture roots.
Only ArchivePreflightReceipt, SourceAcquisitionDryRun, and ArchiveObjectPromotionReceipt become portable contracts.

Runtime dependencies are limited to the package names pydantic, rfc8785, and uuid6; Sol pins exact Python-3.12-compatible versions after a bounded compatibility probe and must stop for design review rather than substitute another package.
The CLI uses the standard library argparse boundary; Typer, Click, a plugin system, provider registry, dependency-injection framework, and generalized storage abstraction are prohibited.
No database, worker, HTTP API, retrieval, model, benchmark execution, cloud, Luna, training, or billable work is introduced.
The root turn ends at one open draft PR for ChatGPT exact-head review.
activated_data_stores: Git repository for code, schemas, approved manifest, and public-safe fixtures.
Temporary test directories carrying an explicit non-authoritative fixture marker for synthetic archive tests only.
Read-only macOS metadata observation of a proposed external volume.
Ignored owner-private .local/evidence/VS01-T01 for the full live preflight receipt only.
activated_adapters: macOS diskutil plist inspection and optional read-only system_profiler correlation without volume mutation.
Local-filesystem synthetic .incoming to SHA-256 object publication using a no-overwrite atomic same-filesystem primitive.
required_tests: Archive-inspection fixtures cover encrypted external APFS Thunderbolt candidate, internal, unencrypted, wrong filesystem, duplicate names, missing identity, unproven protocol, read-only, low-space, unsupported-host, and command-failure states.
Readiness uses the exact 20 GiB free-space floor, requires positive Thunderbolt evidence, and never performs a live write probe.
Private receipt handling excludes stable identifiers, mount paths, host identifiers, and raw profiler output from Git-visible evidence.
SOURCE-PLAN-01 compilation yields exactly six sources with exact revisions or snapshot rules, exclusions, rights lineages, and hard prohibitions.
Mutable WEB package planning fails without an acquisition-time snapshot-hash requirement.
Any training, embedding, cloud, automatic-update, MACULA, apparatus, copyrighted-page, private-source, or model-generated-source authorization fails.
The dry-run semantic payload and RFC 8785 SHA-256 are deterministic even when receipt UUIDv7 and generated-at fields differ.

Synthetic object promotion proves no-overwrite atomic immutable placement, idempotent identical-object handling, corrupt-existing-object failure, truncated-stage failure, path and symlink safety, and concurrent duplicate safety.
Synthetic promotion rejects a root without the exact non-authoritative fixture marker.
Portable contract schemas reject unknown fields and remain byte-current with generated Pydantic schemas.

CLI emits machine-readable records; expected fail-closed readiness is a successful inspection result, while invalid arguments, unsupported execution, or inspection-tool failure return nonzero without traceback leakage.
Tests prevent all external-source network access and verify no source transport implementation exists.
Ruff, Pyright strict, pytest, Hypothesis, and at least 90 percent branch coverage on the new production package pass.
required_evidence: Exact activation, implementation, and live handoff SHAs.
Dependency compatibility and justification receipt for exact pinned pydantic, rfc8785, and uuid6 versions.
Task-specific CI run and local validation summary.
Owner-private live read-only macOS ArchivePreflightReceipt path and SHA-256 plus a non-identifying public summary; the full receipt must not be committed.
Schema-generation drift result and contract-registry inventory.
DR-30 changed-file, line, module, function, complexity, dependency, and public-contract receipt.
Explicit no-external-source-network, no-source-acquisition, no-real-archive-mutation, and no-sensitive-device-metadata-in-Git statement.
explicit_non_goals: No actual source acquisition, clone, download, font retrieval, source-URL probe, or normalization.
No real archive initialization, profile approval, authoritative write, marker creation, or write test.
No PostgreSQL, migration, work queue, worker, API, or web application.
No John 1:5 evidence packet, page fixture, translation diagnosis, or benchmark execution.
No embeddings, vector index, retrieval framework, inference, model download, training, Lambda, Luna, cloud, or billable action.
No generic source connector framework, rights engine, plugin system, dependency-injection framework, network archive adapter, or broad storage API.
prohibited_scaffolding: No future service or package shells, empty namespaces, stubs, TODO implementations, feature flags, provider registry, repository abstraction, or generalized storage layer.
No source-specific transport implementation beyond deterministic dry-run planning records.
No hidden fallback to internal, temporary, network, other removable, or cloud storage.
No changes to benchmark case content, approved source-plan semantics, or W00 historical governance implementation.
No public fixture containing a real volume UUID, device identifier, mount path, host identifier, serial number, or raw system metadata.
completion_criteria: The minimal Python package and locked environment install on Python 3.12.
The two CLI commands produce schema-valid machine-readable output under the defined exit-code semantics.
A live Mac archive inspection produces a truthful candidate or fail-closed private receipt without mutating a volume or exposing sensitive device metadata publicly.
SOURCE-PLAN-01 compiles to an exact six-source dry run with every rights and operation prohibition preserved and a deterministic semantic hash.
Synthetic content-addressed promotion passes all atomicity, identity, fixture-authority, and path-safety tests.
Task-specific CI and all required local checks pass.
No real external source or archive bytes are acquired, probed, initialized, or mutated.
The implementation stays within DR-30 and activation budgets without compression or speculative abstraction.
The final commit contains only the concise VS01-T01 handoff pair.
The PR remains open, draft, unapproved, and unmerged for ChatGPT exact-head review.
